Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lumenix - prepping accelerated drawdown proposal

Hi team,

Lumenix (related DEAL-5729) just asked whether we can frontload their GCP private offer redemption to accelerate Q1 consumption. They want a condensed drawdown over 3 months instead of the originally planned 6. Quick summary of asks from the call this morning:

- Frontload sku consumption so they can hit usage credits in Q1 (marketing alignment).
- Clear invoice schedule that maps to frontloaded redemption amounts.
- Confirmation on co-sell credit timing and GCP reconciliation steps.

Ben — can you draft a proposed burn schedule (monthly %s across the next 3 months) and map to SKUs/units? Marissa — please prepare an "amended offer summary" PDF that lists the changes we will present and a DocuSign wrapper. I want to be ready to propose a specific frontload split to procurement by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: none here.

Thanks,
Olga

Redwood Inference

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the note — yes, we were discussing accelerating the redemption so our analytics platform can scale into new product lines in Q1. A few specifics from our side that will determine feasibility:

- We need the invoice schedule to align with our finance close: ideally one invoice at the start of the month and one mid-month for any true-up.
- Please include the GCP Private Offer ID on every invoice. Our procurement requires the PO mapping for cost center 42-GL.
- Co-sell credits: we need clarity on when credits will be visible in our GCP invoice (month-of vs. lagged).

I've attached our standard PO terms so you can see the billing constraints we have. If you can give a concrete month-by-month % proposal (e.g., 40/30/30) and a draft amended offer, we can review internally and aim to sign next week.

Attachments: Lumenix_PO_Terms.pdf (pdf)

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Lumenix - proposed burn schedule (v2)

Olga / Marissa,

Attached is my proposed burn schedule and SKU mapping. Key points:

- Suggested frontload split: Month 1 = 40%, Month 2 = 35%, Month 3 = 25%. The 35/25 split reduces month-2 risk while still delivering a meaningful Q1 uplift.
- SKU mapping: grouped into two buckets (inference tokens and fine-tune ops) with per-SKU unit counts and estimated token burn.
- Invoice cadence: we recommend one invoice at start of each month with a single mid-month true-up if actual usage exceeds estimates by >10%. That should satisfy Lumenix's desire for a start-of-month invoice while giving us protection on overusage.

I've attached the spreadsheet (burn_schedule_v2.xlsx) with the numbers and a scenario tab showing a 15% downside case. If you want a more aggressive frontload (40/30/30) for marketing reasons we can do it but we'd want a credit buffer in month 1.

Ben
Ben Carter
Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: burn_schedule_v2.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Amended GCP private offer - Lumenix Labs (frontload proposal)

Hi Priya / Rajiv,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Based on our internal review and Ben's scenarios, Redwood can accommodate an accelerated redemption with the following commercial adjustments:

- Agreed frontload split (final): Month 1 = 40%, Month 2 = 30%, Month 3 = 30%.
- Invoice cadence: one invoice at the start of each month (1st business day) plus a single true-up invoice on the 15th if usage exceeds estimates by >10%. Each invoice will include the GCP Private Offer ID (po-98y73a2) on the header.
- Co-sell credits: Redwood will apply partner co-sell credits on a month-of basis where possible; any deferred credits will be reconciled in the next month's invoice and documented in the amended offer appendix.
- DocuSign: I've prepared an "Amended Offer Summary" that reflects the above and includes the invoicing language. Please sign via the DocuSign link below so we can trigger the amended offer in GCP.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/s/abcdef1234567890
GCP Private Offer ID: po-98y73a2

Attachments: amended_offer_summary.pdf (pdf)

If this looks good I will send the DocuSign and route the signed amendment to our finance team for invoice generation. Also happy to do a 30-min sync to walk through reconciliation and the co-sell credit mechanics with Rajiv.

Thanks,
